title: The Summer of Bellbird Bay
author: Emrys Dravenmoor
blurb: Tamsin Hartwell, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
